claims.claim: For engine seating and engine mounting
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows engine mounts and mounting brackets, consistent with this use.
No shipping label, customs tag, or import marking visible in the photo to confirm origin.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: These are properties of a running engine (knock, mileage, opened/unopened), but the report shows only mounts and brackets, not an engine assembly; the claim does not match the item shown.

risks.risk: Rubber bushing condition (cracking, hardening, perishing) not assessable from a static shelf photo
risks.proof: Close-up photo of each rubber mount bushing, flexed by hand, showing no cracks
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn/hardened rubber, lower-tier mount

risks.proof: Clear photo of part number stamped/molded on bracket or mount, or seller statement matched to a VIN/model
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unmatched mount, buyer bears fitment risk

risks.risk: Quantity of items actually included in sale unclear (pile shown may exceed or understate lot)
risks.proof: Photo with items laid out individually and counted, or a count list from seller
risks.if_unproven: priced for minimum visible countable units only

risks.risk: OEM vs aftermarket origin cannot be determined from rust/wear
risks.proof: Close-up of any manufacturer logo or casting marks on metal bracket

risks.risk: Structural integrity of brackets (cracks, weld repairs, corrosion depth) hidden by rust
risks.proof: Multiple angle close-ups of each bracket, especially bolt holes and stress points

risks.risk: Claim of 'low mileage/no knock' implies a tested engine, not mounts; possible mismatched or copy-pasted ad text
risks.proof: Photo/video of the actual running engine these mounts were removed from, with visible mileage odometer
risks.if_unproven: claim disregarded entirely for pricing; treat as unverified boilerplate

proof_requests: Close-up photos of each rubber mount showing bushing condition
Photo of any part numbers or OEM markings on brackets
A count/layout photo showing all items included in the lot
Any import/customs documentation showing Belgium origin
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type as used engine mounts and brackets, so a worst-case price can be set now; the seller's engine-specific claims (knock, mileage) do not match the shown parts and are disregarded pending real proof.
